name: jig.jp co.,ltd.
summary: jig.jp Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that plans, creates and deploys mobile software applications. Its products include Fuwacchi, an app for streaming and viewing video and radio, and jigbrowser, a mobile browser for accessing full desktop websites. It also operates an open data platform and offers a programming tool for children and beginners. Dating from 2003, it has its headquarters in Shibuya, Japan.
